sources.snippet: This page documents the AI-powered image processing feature of ImageToolbox, covering the domain model for neural network models, the AiToolsRepository interface, the AndroidAiToolsRepository implementation for model lifecycle management, the AiProcessor ONNX Runtime inference pipeline with tiled chunk processing, and the associated UI components.

sources.snippet: ImageToolbox is a versatile image editing tool designed for efficient photo manipulation. It allows users to crop, apply filters, edit EXIF data, erase backgrounds, and even enhance images with AI. Ideal for both photographers and developers, the tool offers a simple interface with powerful capabilities.
